countingPolicy: Per-XML counters are actual executions, including reruns; their sum is NOT unique tests or accepted requirements.
Every retained failed XML/case observation remains present. Latest status is matched by exact NUnit case name only.
Renamed/retired cases with no later exact-name observation are historical evidence, not automatic current product failures.
Authoring markers/runner exits are separate from test passes. Missing XML never counts as a pass.
A passing targeted native run does not establish actual Windows, human, hardware, audio, performance or whole-release acceptance.
